All done. Here's what was added to the graph:

**4 priority levels:**
| Priority | Response target | Required role | Notification | Auto-escalate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| low | 24h | any | normal | — |
| normal | 8h | any | normal | — |
| high | 4h | agent+ | immediate_email | — |
| critical | 1h | senior+ | urgent_page | → escalated |

**Permissions added:**
- `set_priority_high`: agent, senior, admin
- `set_priority_critical`: senior, admin

**Effects added:**
- `transition/notification` when `priority-high` (triggers immediate email path)
- `transition/notification` when `priority-critical` (triggers urgent page path)
- `transition/analytics` when `priority-set` (SLA reporting hook)
- `create/analytics` always (tracks ticket creation with initial priority for SLA baseline)

All obligation checks passed across workflow, permissions, notifications, and analytics before projecting.
